value.note: A plank gantry hung over the yard (`base: aloft`): it owns no ground, so the yard's sky under it and the open ground beyond the yard's edge stay the commons. Climbed from the yard through a hole in its deck, walked to the perch.
A small roofed lookout hung at the gantry's far end, over the open ground south of the yard.

why: The perch hung twelve courses under its floor course (`base: {"aloft": 12}`): its claim's bottom drops to y 56, and the open ground south of the yard stands at and above that course under it. An aloft place owns no ground, so terrain inside its claim has no owner that can draw it — `DW0990`'s third shape, read off the plan and the terrain at validation, naming the columns and the remedies: stand the place on the ground, raise its floor, or lower the terrain. It declares no unit: `base` is bound on the site-plan overlay's gantry and perch.
